name: Operating Systems
blurb: Short videos only: every pick is 20 minutes or less and covers one or two ideas, ordered as a sequence. Most come from Mythili Vutukuru's IIT Bombay course, Neso Academy and David Black-Schaffer's short lectures.
method:
• Length: hard cap of 20 minutes per video; depth comes from a sequence.
  • Order: picks in a subtopic are in watching order; the first is the starting point.
  • Sources: Mythili Vutukuru (IIT Bombay, follows Three Easy Pieces), Neso Academy (follows Silberschatz), David Black-Schaffer (Uppsala), and animated explainers (Core Dumped, BitLemon) where a picture helps.
  • Numericals (Gantt charts, Banker's, page replacement, disk scheduling) are covered by the linked MCQs.

subtopics.name: Short-video courses
subtopics.note: Every video on this page is 20 minutes or less, so each subtopic is a sequence of short sittings. These series supply most of them and are worth following in order.

picks.title: Operating Systems (OS) Lectures
